paddy: 💧 **Water Management:** Maintain 2-5 cm water level during reproductive stage.
🧪 **Zinc Deficiency:** If leaves turn rusty brown, apply Zinc Sulphate (25kg/ha).
🐛 **Pest Control:** Use pheromone traps (5/acre) to monitor Stem Borer.
🌾 **Harvest:** Harvest when 80% of grains turn golden yellow.
wheat: 🌱 **Sowing Depth:** Sow seeds at 4-5 cm depth for best germination.
💧 **Critical Irrigation:** Crown Root Initiation (CRI) stage (21 days after sowing) is most critical.
⚠️ **Yellow Rust:** If yellow powder appears on leaves, spray Propiconazole immediately.
🧪 **Fertilizer:** Apply Nitrogen in split doses (1/2 at sowing, 1/2 at first irrigation).
millet: 🌱 **Spacing:** Maintain 25x10 cm spacing for optimal yield.
🐛 **Birds:** Bird scaring is essential during the grain filling stage.
cow: 💉 **Vaccination:** FMD vaccination is mandatory twice a year (Sept/March).
🥛 **Clean Milk:** Wash udder with potassium permanganate solution before milking.
🏠 **Housing:** Ensure dry, non-slippery floor to prevent hoof rotting.
🥗 **Diet:** Provide mineral mixture (50g/day) to improve milk quality.
goat: 🦠 **Deworming:** Deworm every 3 months before monsoon starts.
💉 **PPR Vaccine:** Ensure annual PPR vaccination for all goats above 3 months.
🌿 **Feed:** Green fodder (Subabul/Neem) should make up 50% of the diet.
🏠 **Shelter:** Raised platform housing prevents pneumonia and foot rot.
general: 🚜 **Soil Test:** Test soil every 3 years to save fertilizer costs.
🌦️ **Weather:** Check the 'Weather' tab before spraying any chemicals.
📜 **Insurance:** Insure your crops under PMFBY to protect against calamities.
